# Sathuthuka Driving School

> Sathuthuka Driving School teaches people across KwaZulu-Natal to drive: Code 8 lessons, Code 10 and Code 14 truck training, motorcycle training and learner's licence preparation. Learn to drive. Learn to arrive. The site also offers a free K53 study guide, exam-style practice tests, road-sign and road-rule notes, study videos and testing-centre search.

## Start here

- [Home](/): Courses, contact details and online learner's licence preparation.
- [Free K53 Learners Study Guide](/k53-learners-study-guide): Test sections, pass marks, learner categories, booking checklist, official references and an original PDF summary.
- [K53 Practice Tests](/courses): Exam-style practice for South African learner's licence candidates.
- [K53 Live Notes](/live-notes): Road traffic signs and rules study material.
- [Rules of the Road](/live-notes/rules): Chapter-based road-rule lessons and quizzes.
- [Study Videos](/videos): K53 teaching videos and recorded study sessions.
- [Find a Testing Centre](/centers): Search for nearby Driving Licence Testing Centres.
- [Pricing](/pricing): Full-access package details and current visible price.

## Key facts

- The learner's licence test has three separately scored sections: Rules of the Road, Road Traffic Signs and Vehicle Controls.
- Minimum scores are 22/28 for Rules of the Road, 23/28 for Road Traffic Signs and 6/8 for Vehicle Controls.
- Candidates must pass all three sections.
- Official learner's licence categories are Code 1, Code 2 and Code 3.
